title: publish-pool manifest
description: A run declaring itself finished, posted to POST /api/ingest/manifest. Freshness moves on this and on nothing else, and only when every batch number 1..batches has been acknowledged (CONTRACTS §2).

per_source.description: One entry per source the run touched, keyed by source name.

error.description: Shown verbatim on the public status page, so a short summary with no urls, tokens or paths. The API truncates anything longer than this.

enabled.description: The fetch switch the publisher read at the start of the run: what tells the status page `disabled` from `failed`.
